queries_run: KLAC KLA tariff section 232 semiconductor equipment 2026
KLA export control entity list China semiconductor equipment 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：美國對中國出口管制（Entity List、2022/2023 BIS 規則）限制 KLA 對中國先進製程客戶的銷售、出貨與支援，無法保證出口許可會獲准，影響可能重大。
findings.excerpt: Commerce may continue to add China-based entities to the U.S. Entity List and impose other end use or end user export restrictions, which could disrupt or prevent our product shipments to China-based entities, and further disrupt our revenue recognition, business operations and our ability to support our customers in China.

findings.claim: 2025-09 BIS 發布 Affiliates Rule（持股50%以上關聯方納入管制），2025-11 暫停一年至 2026-11。
findings.excerpt: In November 2025, the BIS suspended the Affiliates Rule for one year until November 2026.

findings.claim: Section 232 半導體及設備調查結果未知，可能帶來額外關稅；既有關稅已推升KLA進口零組件成本；2026-02 最高法院裁定IEEPA關稅無授權，關稅與退款不確定性升高。
findings.excerpt: The U.S. tariffs have increased our cost of revenues due to the increase in the cost of importing foreign sourced components to our U.S. facilities to build the products that we manufacture in the U.S.

findings.claim: 2026-04 BIS 出口管制更新被報導為KLA FY2026 營收逆風（限制特定先進設備出口及對特定中國客戶服務），股價當日跌約4.2%；二手聚合來源，未核一手。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance 文章（搜尋摘要）
findings.excerpt: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after a major U.S. wafer-fab equipment company disclosed an expected revenue headwind for fiscal 2026 tied to an export-control update from the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS).

reg_tariff_export.note: 未找到2026-04 BIS 規則的一手 Federal Register；TipRanks 估算中國銷售影響$300–350M 為分析師推估，未列入。Section 232 1月公告為窄範圍先進晶片25%，設備端未確認。
